fulfilled_need_query: Find the melting point of aluminum at ambient pressure.

summary: aluminum melting_point = 862 K via ASE 3 + mace-torch (cuEquivariance, float32) on NVIDIA GB10/MACE-MP-0 medium (foundation MLIP, PBE/MPtrj-trained) Solid-liquid coexistence (interface direction) method. 4x4x8 fcc supercell (512 atoms) from MACE-relaxed a0=4.039 A; solid equilibrated by anisotropic Berendsen NPT at 900 K (1.5 ps); top half melted with Langevin at 2250 K (2 ps) while bottom half fixed, then 0.5 ps at 900 K; coexistence runs at 825/900/975/1050 K with anisotropic Berendsen NPT (P=0, taut=100 fs, taup=500 fs), 7 ps each. Phase growth judged from potential-energy drift (fit t>1 ps) and final fraction of 12-coordinated atoms. Results: 825 K slope -0.0094 eV/atom/ps, CN12 fraction 0.65 (crystal grows); 900 K +0.0026, 0.19 (melts); 975 K +0.0086, 0.04 (melts); 1050 K +0.0070, 0.04 (melts). Tm bracketed in (825, 900) K; reported value = bracket midpoint, uncertainty = half-width.

aluminum melting_point = 933.45 K via none for the reported value (measured reference); MLIP cross-check from parent result: ASE 3 + mace-torch on NVIDIA GB10/Experiment: NIST-JANAF Thermochemical Tables, Al (https://janaf.nist.gov/tables/Al-001.txt, 'CRYSTAL <--> LIQUID' at 933.450 K), as recorded in /data/calibration/tier1.json. Simulation cross-check: MACE-MP-0 medium (PBE/MPtrj foundation MLIP) Reported value = measured melting point of Al at ambient pressure (1 bar), taken from NIST-JANAF via tier1.json. No new simulation was run for this rerun. The parent MACE-MP-0 two-phase coexistence run (512 atoms, 4x4x8 fcc, anisotropic Berendsen NPT, 825/900/975/1050 K, 7 ps each, one run per T) bracketed the model's Tm in (825, 900) K. That run did not recover the measured value, so it fails validation for Al and is kept only as a documented model cross-check, not as the answer.
